Straight line winds from a severe thunderstorm resulted in damage across the west side of Beeville. A 4 by 8 section of a one story apartment on West Fannin St. was blown off by the winds. There was damage to large tree limbs in the area and a large hackberry tree was blown down,…
A NWS Storm Survey found large trees down near Tynan. Several large metal highway signs were broken off at base.

A supercell moved southeast across Live Oak County into Bee County. This storm produced a 5 to 10 mile swath of damage mainly due to high winds. A couple of semi-trucks were turned over along Interstate 37. Several power poles were snapped or leaned over along with highway signs …

An NWS Survey concluded and EF-1 tornado touched down approximately 1.5 miles southeast of Tynan, in a grain field south of FM 796. The tornado was approximately 1/4 mile wide, and on the ground for roughly 2.51 miles in San Patricio County before crossing into Bee County. The to…
Winds downed several trees near Chase Field.
Winds blew down power lines into trees in the central sections of Beeville.
Minor roof damage to some homes and two uprooted trees were reported in Beeville.
Pea to quarter sized hail occurred in the city of Beeville.
Spotter reported quarter sized hail in the northeast side of the city of Beeville.
Storm chaser group observed a brief tornado about 3 miles southwest of Pawnee. The tornado touched down in an open field. No damage was observed.

Storm Chaser group observed a cyclic tornadic supercell produce a brief second tornado about 1.5 miles west of Pawnee, immediately to the north of the previous tornado and from a second wall cloud. The tornado touched down in an open field. No damage was observed.
Storm chaser group observed a third and slightly larger tornado touch down northwest of Pawnee. The tornado touched down in an open field. No damage was observed.
Spotter reported mostly nickel sized hail with some golf ball sized hail to the southwest of Beeville.
Golf ball sized hail occurred at the Central Fire Station in Beeville.
Thunderstorm winds blew a porch off of a mobile home. A large tree was blown down also.

A tree with the diameter of two feet was snapped by the wind at a home in the Clareville subdivision.
Large basketball set tossed about 20 feet across the yard causing damage to the porch.
Spotter reported several wind gusts to at least 60 mph.
Spotter reported quarter sized hail 5 miles east of Tynan.

MPING report received of half dollar sized hail in Normanna.

Pictures relayed through social media of significant property damage near Mineral.

Beeville Municipal Airport AWOS measured a gust to 81 mph. Damage occurred to a couple of storage buildings at the airport.
Ham radio operator reported golf ball sized hail near Papalote.
